categories.title: Programming Foundations
categories.description: Learn how software represents data, makes decisions, repeats work, organizes behavior, handles errors, and communicates with other systems.

categories.title: Android Development
categories.description: Build native Android apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, from screens and state to storage, permissions, networking, and device APIs.

categories.title: Electronics
categories.description: Understand voltage, current, resistance, signals, components, power, sensors, and the practical rules that keep hardware alive.

categories.title: ESP32
categories.description: Program ESP32 boards, use GPIO, ADC, PWM, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, sensors, and build connected embedded projects.

categories.title: Raspberry Pi
categories.description: Use Linux, GPIO, networking, cameras, services, Python, and local processing on Raspberry Pi systems.

categories.title: Networking
categories.description: Understand IP, ports, TCP, UDP, DNS, HTTP, Wi‑Fi, routing, packet flow, APIs, and troubleshooting.

categories.title: Device Interfaces & Protocols
categories.description: Learn UART, I²C, SPI, CAN, USB, BLE, NFC, infrared, MQTT, WebSockets, and how devices exchange data.

categories.title: Data & Visualization
categories.description: Turn raw device output into clean records, useful charts, alerts, maps, statistics, and searchable history.

categories.title: Weather Technology
categories.description: Build and understand weather instrumentation, sensor placement, calibration, logging, and dashboards.

categories.title: Drones & Flight Systems
categories.description: Understand motors, ESCs, IMUs, control loops, flight controllers, telemetry, GPS, and autonomous flight concepts.

categories.title: RC Cars & Aircraft
categories.description: Learn radio control, servos, motor control, receivers, batteries, telemetry, and custom controllers.

categories.title: Automotive & Dash Cameras
categories.description: Understand OBD‑II, CAN, GPS, dash-camera storage and networking, vehicle telemetry, and owner-authorized data interfaces.

categories.title: Flipper & Hardware Tools
categories.description: Use portable hardware tools to learn IR, NFC, RFID, Sub‑GHz concepts, GPIO, UART, and diagnostics on systems you own or are authorized to test.

categories.title: Safe Device Analysis
categories.description: Learn observation, logging, protocol identification, authentication concepts, and defensive testing without crossing into unauthorized access.

projects.title: Build an ESP32 Weather Station
projects.description: Learn electronics, sensors, Wi‑Fi, structured data, logging, and Android visualization by building a complete environmental monitor.
projects.outcome: An offline-capable Android dashboard receiving trustworthy weather readings from an ESP32-based station.

projects.title: Build a Better Dash-Camera Dashboard
projects.description: Learn owner-authorized device networking, structured data, storage, GPS correlation, and Android UI design.
projects.outcome: A custom Android interface that organizes data your own camera legitimately exposes and correlates it with recordings.

projects.title: Build a BLE Sensor Interface
projects.description: Learn BLE from electronics to services and characteristics, then build a native Android monitor.
projects.outcome: An Android app that connects to your ESP32 BLE sensor and displays timestamped readings.

projects.title: Build an RC Telemetry & Control Interface
projects.description: Learn motor control, radio/control concepts, BLE, safety states, and Android control UI.
projects.outcome: A safe, owner-built Android control/telemetry interface with explicit neutral/failsafe behavior.

projects.title: Understand and Build a Drone Ground-Station Viewer
projects.description: Learn flight systems and telemetry, then visualize authorized telemetry on Android.
projects.outcome: An Android learning ground-station viewer that explains and displays telemetry from supported systems you own or are authorized to use.

projects.title: Build a Raspberry Pi Sensor Gateway
projects.description: Learn Linux, services, networking, Python, and data pipelines on Raspberry Pi.
projects.outcome: A headless Raspberry Pi service that collects local sensor data and exposes a clean API to Android.

projects.title: Flipper Hardware Learning Lab
projects.description: Use Flipper as a legal learning tool for your own equipment while learning radio and wired interface fundamentals.
projects.outcome: A structured hardware-analysis learning path that stays focused on owned or explicitly authorized devices.

projects.title: Build a Native Android Technical Dashboard
projects.description: Start from Kotlin and build an offline-first device/data dashboard.
projects.outcome: A native Kotlin/Compose Android app with meaningful state, storage, charts, and network data.
